summary: The first statement of how the Network Working Group's notes should work. Anyone at any site could write a note, and notes were meant to be timely rather than polished, covering host software and other aspects of the network. This informal approach is the origin of the Request for Comments series. It was replaced by RFC 10.

eli5.summary: This note sets the club rules for sharing ideas: anyone can write one, and a rough idea shared fast is better than a perfect one shared late.
